question: where did attendance percentage decline the most year on year
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) , by_year AS (SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre) SELECT centre, avg_2023 - avg_2024 AS drop_pp FROM by_year ORDER BY drop_pp DESC, centre LIMIT 1

CURRENT QUESTION:
where did attendance percentage decline the most year on year
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH attendance_combined AS (
  SELECT
    "Centre" AS centre,
    "Month" AS month,
    "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolment,
    "Avg Daily Present" AS attendance,
    2023 AS year
  FROM "attendance_2023"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "centre_name" AS centre,
    "month" AS month,
    "enrolment" AS enrolment,
    "average_attendance" AS attendance,
    2024 AS year
  FROM "attendance_2024"
),
monthly_rates AS (
  SELECT
    centre,
    month,
    year,
    (attendance * 100.0 / NULLIF(enrolment, 0)) AS attendance_pct
  FROM attendance_combined
),
year_over_year AS (
  SELECT
    m24.centre,
    m24.month,
    m23.attendance_pct AS pct_2023,
    m24.attendance_pct AS pct_2024,
    (m24.attendance_pct - m23.attendance_pct) AS pct_point_change
  FROM monthly_rates m24
  JOIN monthly_rates m23 ON m24.centre = m23.centre 
    AND m24.month = m23.month 
    AND m23.year = 2023 
    AND m24.year = 2024
)
SELECT
  centre,
  month,
  pct_2023,
  pct_2024,
  pct_point_change
FROM year_over_year
ORDER BY pct_point_change ASC
LIMIT 1;
```
